snippet.title: Orium - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
New demo available on August 11, 2025 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3505100/Orium_Demo/

The galaxy is yours! Aboard your ship, exterminate your enemies, exploit planets and weave your enterprise across the stars to satisfy your employer. Orium is a space roguelite with 4X elements.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/2gHqPUVzFw
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/vaelynn.bsky.social
itch: https://exe-ko.itch.io/orium
